question: Which of the following pairs of countries hosted 2022 FIVA Volleyball Women’s World Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Poland and Netherlands.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poland and Netherlands** are going to host the **2022 FIVA Volleyball Women's World Championship.**
 
• The FIVA Volleyball Women's World Championship is an** international volleyball tournament** organized by the International Volleyball Federation (FIVB) for **women's national teams.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **22nd FIVB Volleyball Women's U21** World Championship took place in **2023**.
 
• It was held in **Mexico** from **August 17–26, 2023.**
 
• **China **defeated Italy **3–2** in the championship game to win their fourth U21 World Championship.​
